incident.title: API gateway outage due to certificate expiry in edge fleet
incident.customer_impact: Approximately 62% of API requests failed with TLS handshake errors for 2h 35m. Webhook deliveries were queued and replayed after recovery; no data was lost. 41 enterprise customers were affected, 18 support tickets were opened.

timeline.event: Leaf certificate on edge proxy fleet eu-west expires; TLS handshakes begin failing
PagerDuty alert edge-tls-error-rate fires; on-call SRE acknowledges
Incident declared SEV-1, incident channel #inc-0342 opened
Root cause identified: cert-manager renewal job stuck since 2026-06-24 due to revoked API token
New certificate issued manually and pushed to 12 of 48 edge nodes
Rollout completed to all edge nodes; error rate below 1%
Webhook backlog fully drained; incident resolved

root_cause: The cert-manager renewal CronJob had been failing silently since 2026-06-24 because its Vault API token was revoked during a quarterly credential rotation. The job's failure alerts were routed to a decommissioned Slack channel, so the expiring certificate went unnoticed until it lapsed in production.

action_items.action: Route cert-manager job failures to PagerDuty with SEV-2 priority
Add synthetic TLS expiry probe (alert at 14 days remaining)
Include service tokens in rotation runbook checklist
Automate staged cert rollout to edge fleet
